title: STUXS Music 2.0 — Build 9
releaseNotes: Authoritative Previous Song navigation across UI, notification, lock-screen, headset/Bluetooth, and MediaSession
Standard music-player restart threshold: resets to 0:00 when track position > 3 seconds without altering queue position
Instant previous track navigation when within initial 3 seconds of playback
Accurate Repeat ONE restarting and Repeat ALL wrap-around without negative index or crash at queue boundaries
Eliminated double-advance and dual-triggering between React player controller and native Media3 engine
Deep audio container magic-byte verification rejecting HTML/XML error pages and JSON error payloads
Authoritative container detection ensuring MP4/M4A/AAC files receive explicit MIME types on Media3 MediaItems
Canonical multi-signal offline track matching resolving downloads across catalog and provider ID variations
Atomic write stream synchronization guaranteeing full disk commit before download finalization
